question: During Prime Minister Narendra Modi's visit to Bratislava in June 2026, India and Slovakia officially elevated their bilateral relationship to which of the following statuses?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Comprehensive Partnership**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Prime Minister **Narendra Modi** visited **Bratislava, Slovakia**, in June 2026 to review and strengthen bilateral relations with the European nation.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• During the talks between **PM Modi** and Slovak Prime Minister **Robert Fico**, both nations decided to elevate their bilateral ties to a **Comprehensive Partnership**.
 
• This elevation reflects the strong potential of the ties between the two countries and aims to broaden cooperation across various sectors.
 
• The leaders also agreed to establish a **Joint Working Group (JWG) on counter-terrorism** to combat global terrorism in a sustained manner.
 
• The **India-EU Free Trade Agreement (FTA)** was highlighted by PM Modi as a factor that will add momentum to this newly elevated partnership.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Several Memorandums of Understanding (MoUs) were signed in fields including **Digital Technologies**, **Labour Migration**, **Quantum Communication**, and **Critical Infrastructure Protection**.
 
• The first-ever **ICCR Chair in Artificial Intelligence** was established at the **Technical University of Kosice** in Slovakia.
 
• An agreement was finalized between **IIT Delhi** and **Slovak Technical University** for research collaboration and student exchange programmes.
 
• PM Modi was conferred with Slovakia’s highest civilian honour, the **'Order of the White Double Cross'**.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__**

 
• The elevation to a **Comprehensive Partnership** signifies a deeper level of engagement compared to standard diplomatic relations.
 
• The establishment of a mechanism for **regular consular consultations** was also agreed upon to facilitate the growing movement of people between the two nations.
